name: RepViT
plain: RepViT (Wang et al. 2024): a mobile CNN classifier laid out like a ViT, re-parameterised to plain convolutions.
summary: RepViT (Wang et al. 2024): a mobile CNN with the block layout of a ViT (3x3 depthwise token mixer, 1x1 channel mixer), re-parameterised to plain convolutions at load.

papers.title: RepViT: Revisiting Mobile CNN From ViT Perspective

official.reason: timm carries the architecture and the converted authors' checkpoints in its own, simpler API.

limitations: The older aliases `repvit_m1` / `repvit_m2` / `repvit_m3` (`.dist_in1k`) that timm also lists are not shipped.
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: ImageNet-1k class logits.

variants.name: repvit_m0_9

licence.training_note: ImageNet-1k with distillation from a RegNetY-16GF teacher (RepViT paper), 300 or 450 epochs

variants.input_size: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 235) and centre-cropped to it

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original32.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

quality.title: ImageNet-1k val, 5000 random images, top-1 / top-5 %
quality.protocol: fastforks: the model's own resize / crop on the GPU; original: the library's pretrained loader and its PIL eval transform.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 2.5e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.0094 and p99 <= 0.036 (absolute error of the output `logits`).
